newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong, Japan economic bodies sign cooperation.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong, Japan economic bodies sign cooperation.

text.p: A Hong Kong trade promotion body signed a cooperation agreement on Saturday with an influential Japanese business group.
The Hong Kong Trade Development Council said in a statement it had signed the pact with Japan's Kansai Economic Federation, which represents about 860 companies and organisations.

The agreement encompasses mutual undertakings to assist activities including major conventions, trade fairs, information exchanges and trade missions between Hong Kong and Japan's Kansai region, which accounts for one-fifth of the Japanese economy and three percent of the world economy, it said.
Japan is Hong Kong's third largest trading partner, with bilateral trade reaching almost US$40 billion last year.
